recentItems.title: 'Trump-a-palooza' aims to energize Republican base
recentItems.description: Republicans gathered Wednesday night in Dallas for the first-ever Republican midterm convention, an event designed to energize voters, raise money and highlight key candidates ahead of the November election. CNN’s Alayna Treene takes us through the key moments.

recentItems.title: This NGO is cleaning up “dead” rivers in Indonesia
recentItems.description: Over the past six years, nonprofit group Sungai Watch has cleaned up about 5,500 tons of non-organic waste from rivers across Indonesia. Jumping into waterways swamped with trash is “one of the most uncomfortable” situations imaginable, and yet the group’s co-founder tells CNN why he and his team keep doing it, day after day. #cnn #news #indonesia

recentItems.title: Former President Bush and Condoleezza Rice reflect on 9/11
recentItems.description: Former US President George W. Bush and former US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice reflect on 9/11 ahead of its 25th anniversary.

recentItems.title: Former Anthropic researcher warns AI could ‘kill us all’
recentItems.description: Former AI researcher Jacob Coxon tells CNN’s Anderson Cooper why he quit Anthropic over fears that rapidly advancing AI could become impossible to control.

recentItems.title: 9/11 First responders say documents prove they were right about air quality
recentItems.description: Despite evidence that the air at Ground Zero was unsafe after September 11, officials allegedly kept first responders and residents from knowing the truth, newly released documents show. CNN's Jason Carroll reports.

recentItems.title: Trump vows $5,000 payments for US adults if GOP wins midterms
recentItems.description: President Donald Trump vowed to pay American adults $5,000 if Republicans retain control of the House and Senate, but didn't say how the payments would be funded.

recentItems.title: Trump touts his ‘America’ renamings
recentItems.description: President Donald Trump used his keynote speech at the GOP’s midterm convention in Dallas to tout accomplishments including his renaming of landmarks, including his renamings of "Lake Ontario, and Gulf of Mexico."

recentItems.title: Ex-Anthropic insider tells CNN how AI could kill all humans by 2030
recentItems.description:
"We do not yet have a plan."

After his warning post went viral, ex-Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon joined CNN's Anderson Cooper to explain exactly how AI could kill us all by the end of the decade—and why his former bosses secretly agree with him.

In this exclusive interview, Coxon exposes the terrifying reality behind closed doors at the world's leading AI labs, warning that tech giants are "gambling with our lives" in a reckless race to build superintelligence.
